messages:
ajay: heads-up: PR #5090 (function-calling examples) assumes the tool returns an object `{id: string, meta: {...}}`, but we've seen LLM outputs return just the `id` string in some cases. broke a bunch of consumer tests. cc @hannah @lucy

hannah: oh interesting. which example? can you paste the failing snippet?

ajay: under `tools > return shapes` there's an example response: `{"tool_output": {"id":"abc123","meta":{...}}}`. our parser chokes when it gets `"tool_output": "abc123"`. failing trace: 
```
Error: Expected object at path tool_output, got string
    at validateOutput (/repo/docs/validators.js:78)
    at Object.parse (/repo/sdk/parse_tool.ts:302)
```

lucy: this is the classic union/alias case. docs should show both canonical full-object shape and a compact legacy alias. propose: add a paired example (object + string) and a tiny section titled "Accepting legacy compact outputs" with a normalization shim.

hannah: Agreed. Also add a JSON Schema snippet using `anyOf`/`oneOf` so people don't blindly paste a strict object schema into their validators. Example idea: 
```json
{"oneOf": [
  {"type": "object", "properties": {"id": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["id"]},
  {"type": "string"}
]}
```

ajay: can we include both JS and Python normalizer snippets? some of our customers copy-paste into backend services. for python: 
```py
# normalize compact -> object
if isinstance(resp.get("tool_output"), str):
    resp["tool_output"] = {"id": resp["tool_output"]}
```
and JS: 
```js
const out = resp.tool_output;
resp.tool_output = typeof out === 'string' ? {id: out} : out;
```

lucy: i'll add a short callout that this normalization is safe as long as metadata is never embedded in the compact string case (we still recommend migrating producers to the full shape). also add a note in the migration guide under "Compatible shape changes".

hannah: +1. please show the schema `oneOf` and also show how to write a validator snippet that coerces the compact case before strict validation (small code example). avoids confusing folks who copy only the schema.

ajay: i'll open the SDK PR with a helper `coerce_tool_output` and tests that cover both shapes. i'll link it from the docs PR.

docs-bot: PR #5090 updated by lucy: added compact+full examples, jsonschema `oneOf`, JS/Python normalization snippets — requested review from @hannah :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: docs-ci: build passed for branch lucy/docs-tool-output-alias (check: lint, md-links) 

hannah: awesome. timeline?

lucy: i'll finish the docs edits in the next 45m and tag @ajay for the SDK link. can we merge together so the docs reference the helper?

ajay: yes aiming to have the SDK PR open before EOD PT. i'll ping here when it's up.

hannah: small nit: in the examples, prefer `oneOf` over `anyOf` because it communicates exclusivity. add a tiny sentence explaining why.

lucy: good catch, updated wording.

ajay: thanks all. this will save a lot of confused users copying strict schemas. :thumbsup:

hannah: will do a quick review once both PRs are linked.

lucy: pinged reviewers. closing loop soon.
